In today’s episode of The Daily Brief, we take a deep dive into one key story and cover another story shaping Indian and global markets:
Story 1: Why Oil Prices Are Still Rising
Global oil prices remain high despite crude shipments from the Gulf recovering to pre-war levels. Damaged refineries, rising shipping costs and falling oil inventories are keeping fuel supplies tight, particularly for diesel.
